description: National Artificial Intelligence Research and Development Strategic Plan: 2023 Update (May 23, 2023). Multi-year federal strategic plan for artificial intelligence research and development issued by the National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence and the Networking and Information Technology Research and Development (NITRD) Program.
